verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Chargebee generates invoices (quotes convert to invoices) and can export invoice data, plus VAT collection is configurable per community reports, but there is no documentation covering sequential invoice/credit-note numbering, credit notes, receipts, custom fields, memos, or automatic customer delivery of these documents. missing for 10: credit note generation, receipt generation, sequential numbering guarantees, custom fields/memos on invoices, automatic delivery mechanism to customers.
